Diagnosis: In `parse_binding`'s error path (parser.py:170), `_rest_of_line = r"[^
]*(?:|
|
)?"` matches `` before `
`, so a CRLF is only half-consumed. The leftover `
` is then eaten by `_multiline_whitespace` at the start of the next binding, so the valid binding's `original.string` begins with `
` and its line stays 1; the invalid binding's string also lacks the trailing `
`. (`_end_of_line` at line 29 already orders `
|
|` correctly.)

Plan: reorder `_rest_of_line` to `r"[^
]*(?:
|
|)?"` in src/dotenv/parser.py. This consumes CRLF as one newline, giving the invalid binding the full CRLF and the valid binding `original.string == "GOOD=ok
"` at line 2. LF and lone-CR behavior and repeated invalid lines are preserved. No other edits needed.
